youtube_title: Jesus... Why Couldn't I Answer When She Asked If You're Real? | John 20:29 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... my friend asked me how I know You're real. Why couldn't I answer her?

Her friend asked how she knows God is real. She laughed, changed the topic, and lay awake wondering if she even knows.

Her: Jesus... my friend asked me how I know You're real. Why couldn't I answer her?

Her: I just laughed and changed the topic. Then I lay awake wondering if I even know.

Jesus: Not having the words ready doesn't mean you don't have Me.

Her: But she had so many reasons. I only had a feeling. And feelings change.

Jesus: Thomas had questions too. He wanted to see My hands. I didn't send him away. I came back for him.

Her: You showed him. You're not showing me. I can't see anything.

Jesus: Look back at the nights you made it through. The prayer someone prayed for you when you couldn't. You've seen more of Me than you think.

"Then Jesus told him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”"
John 20:29 (NIV)

Jesus: You don't need every answer tonight. You can tell her the truth. You're still searching, and I haven't left.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.

When was the last time you felt sure God was real? 🙏 Tell us in the comments.
